_note: Future direct-purchase, donation and Members Lounge links, the email sign-up form action (community_url: the https:// address of the fan community (the Community page's 'Join your country's room' button opens it); email_signup_url: the https:// endpoint of a newsletter service's sign-up form, which receives a POST with an 'email' field), and the press contact (an https:// URL or an email address). Leave null to show the disabled 'Coming soon' placeholders. Fill in an https:// URL and rebuild (python3 tools/build_data.py --skip-covers) to switch a button on. Don't put prices here; the store sets them. goatcounter_code: just the GoatCounter site code (e.g. 'bfomantis'); null = no analytics script at all. merch_url: the https:// address of the merch store; while null the Merch page (merch/) shows 'Coming soon' with disabled buttons. merch_items: the product cards on the Merch page (release = release slug whose cover art is shown, kind, name, url). An item's own https url makes just that button live; otherwise it uses merch_url. No prices here.
